observations: Skill injection emits metrics and passes skill invocation facts to the analytics client. This is not a documented complete local per-turn catalog/invocation event stream.
The inspected analytics record_fact method uses an optional queue and try_send; absence of an exported fact is not proof of no invocation.
The inspected catalog-render telemetry reports aggregate counts and truncation, not a candidate-specific rendered-membership record.
AEEP keeps candidate exposed/retrieved/invoked unknown where these observations are unavailable. Local collector fault tests retain missing and incomplete export states.
conclusion: Current discovery evidence is insufficient for the native-catalog completion gate. This is an observation gap, not a budget or operator-approval blocker, and does not invalidate independent qualification or marginal-value evidence.
remedy: Use a supported candidate-specific per-turn catalog and skill observation stream with a verifiable completion boundary, or separately design and verify an explicitly labelled instrumented-host experiment. Do not replace native discovery, treat absent counters as false, or present a custom host as unmodified Codex.
actions_not_taken: No desktop Codex binary or configuration changed
No upstream source patch built or installed
